rationale: Opted-in projects now block implementation of every nontrivial authored plan until an exact fresh material-decision assessment is clear or its decision-required categories complete the reviewed recommendation and owner-resolution chain; process-generated bypasses require exact core recomputation.
migration: After publishing the immutable authority, adopt the target-version project migration to enable provenance-gated-authored-review. New nontrivial authored plans then use plan schema 3 provenance and a fresh plan-decision review before change implement; decision-required assessments must complete the existing recommendation review and owner-resolution chain. Registered generated plans bypass semantic assessment only when core exactly recomputes the complete plan from bound inputs and authority. Historical plan schemas 1 and 2 remain readable, and projects without opt-in retain released behavior.
